meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制 AI 的记忆规则并验证生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望 AI 按你的规则记住重要信息并主动提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize your AI's memory rules and verify them live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI to remember key info and alert you per your own rules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像访谈一样问你正在做什么，帮你设计一套专属的笔记规则（观察类型和标签），经你确认后安装到 claude-mem，可选配 Telegram 提醒，重启并验证生效。
howto.when: 当你提出要定制 claude-mem 记什么、创建或改模式、添加笔记类型或标签、以及针对特定记忆发 Telegram 通知时，即使你没说“模式”二字，也会触发。

say.text: 我写法律案例时，帮我建个模式记下裁判规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: Claude 会开始访谈并设计专属笔记类型和标签。

say.text: 把实验结论和成本发现作为提醒类型，失败实验也记下来。
say.note: 它会据此提出模式草案，经你确认后安装并重启验证。

say.text: 这个模式的笔记里，客户名字不要记也别发到 Telegram。
say.note: 隐私边界会写进规则，提醒触发时也不会包含这些内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude interviews you about what you are working on, designs a custom note taxonomy (observation types and concepts), installs it to claude-mem after approval, optionally sets up Telegram alerts, then restarts and verifies it is active.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for specific memories, even without using the word "mode."

say_en.text: I record legal cases; set up a mode for case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Claude starts an interview to design your note types and tags.

say_en.text: Alert me on experiment outcomes and cost findings, including failures.
say_en.note: It proposes a mode, then installs and verifies it after approval.

say_en.text: Never record client names or send them to Telegram in this mode.
say_en.note: The privacy boundary is baked into the mode and alerts.
